note: NY-close read, Mon 2026-11-23 (~3:00 PM CT). Dollar extends to a fresh 19-month high — DXY 104.20 — as the Nvidia relief rally (Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO; S&P +4.9%, Nasdaq +6.7%) and a fully-priced Dec hike drove the greenback; EUR/USD 1.0889 is a 19-month low and GBP/USD 1.3023 a one-year low, USD/JPY 159.15 pressing toward 160. US flash PMIs were soft — services missed 54.7 vs 55.6 fcst, mfg in line at 54.5 — and did not dent hike pricing (~96%). Oil broke down: Brent $89.25 (-3.6%) and WTI $80.29 (-3.6%) as surplus fears outweighed Gulf shipping attacks and fresh US Treasury sanctions on Iran's shadow-banking network. Gold $3,645 (+3.4% vs Friday) keeps recovering from the 14-month low. Yields: 2Y ~4.70%, 10Y 5.04%. Williams speaks 3:00 PM CT. Wednesday's 7:30am CT cluster (core PCE, Q3 GDP 2nd estimate, claims) plus the Beige Book is the week's big data day; US markets closed Thursday for Thanksgiving. Spot levels are indicative index quotes, not executable prices.
